'''Z'paul Diin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and made himself a career as an explorer. He attended the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]'', on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
